home.title: Welcome to Tekthib
home.subtitle: Tunisian Online Card Game
home.description: Play smart, bluff well, and be the first to get rid of all your cards. Challenge your friends in this exciting game of deception and strategy!
home.createRoomDescription: Start a new game and invite friends
home.joinRoomDescription: Join an existing game with a room code
home.publicRoomDesc: Anyone can see and join your room
home.privateRoomDesc: Players need the room code to join
home.availableRoomsDescription: Click on a room to join
home.goalDescription: Be the first to get rid of all your cards. Last player with cards loses.
home.gameplayDescription: Play cards face-down and announce a rank. Others can challenge if they think you're lying!
home.bluffingDescription: You don't need the cards you claim to have. Bluff wisely!
home.specialRuleDescription: Collect all 4 cards of the same rank to remove them permanently.
home.joinPrivateRoomDescription: This is a private room. Please enter the room code (password) to join.
home.cannotJoinInProgress: Cannot join, game already in progress
